calibration.note: every parameter below is measured from the trace at build time; none is hardcoded

completion_p99.note: the trace's p99 at n=75 IS its single largest observation, so it is one data point rather than a tail estimate. Lengths are resampled from the full empirical distribution, so the workload's own p99 varies with the draw; compare completion_max and tail_count below to confirm the tail is present rather than truncated.

deterministic: same seed and same trace file reproduce this file byte for byte

multi_tenancy.note: NOT trace-derived. The trace was a single client with 3 schemas, which cannot characterise a shared queue. Client count and stratum spread are a design choice so the queue exercises all four Cold-Start strata.
